correctness.rationale: The real symmetric irreducible Jacobi matrix has simple eigenvalues; its exponential basis Gramian is positive definite for every T>0. The spectral/Vandermonde argument gives det W_j=F(T,p,q,r)(det K_j)^2 with common F>0. Exact degree-six polynomial identities for all four Krylov determinants are proved by explicit computation and a complete seven-point-per-coordinate rational interpolation certificate; the phase ordering then follows from two monotone affine forms A,B, threshold ordering theta-2p=-Delta/(p-r), and A+B=Delta. Reflection and p=r cover all positive parameter tuples. Three-state determinant ratios yield strict minimality. All boundaries and quantifiers are included; 26,460 finite samples supplement rather than replace the analysis.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Dilip 2019 covers the general fixed-weight placement question by an exact spectral-product algorithm. In the inspected full manuscript, it does not identify the first path size admitting a uniquely interior optimum or prove the threshold 2+sqrt(3) and the exact weighted-path tie sets. The present result is intentionally only the explicit domain-wide four-path classification, not an algorithmic improvement or general horizon independence. This close dominance is the principal residual priority risk.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: For an arbitrary fixed (p,q,r), the identity that some vertex maximizes the determinant, and the ability to compute it via the spectral rule, are directly prior-covered. The published general theorem alone does not state which vertex wins for every triple, nor prove the nonlinear parameter boundary and coincidence of two crossing thresholds exactly at p/r=2+sqrt(3), or the minimal graph-size classification. The independent added work is computing exact four degree-six Krylov determinants and proving a global semialgebraic phase diagram. Accordingly novelty is assessed only for those strict additions, not for the general Gramian facts.

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Single-vertex observability is dual to single-vertex controllability for the symmetric generator, and maximizing the determinant equals maximizing the product of modal observation coefficients. That general equivalence and horizon independence are fully acknowledged as known. The claimed extra content is a symbolic, exhaustive partition of the three-dimensional conductance domain, including all tie strata and minimal size, not a different name for the prior spectral factorization.

originality.rationale: The full three-parameter weighted four-vertex path classification (including all ties, sharp outer-link bifurcation at 2+sqrt(3), and minimality among paths with <=4 vertices) is not stated in any directly inspected primary source or surfaced by the searches. Known general spectral-product rules and horizon independence are excluded as novel and expressly credited to Dilip 2019. A general algorithm can decide an individual triple, but does not itself provide the analytic parameter-phase proof; this is nevertheless a significant residual implication risk.
residual_risks: A separate weighted-path-specific graph-polynomial/leader-centrality paper may already classify these conductance phases under different terminology.

Dilip 2019 is so broad that the present law is a concrete nontrivial specialization of its exact rule; some novelty standards could regard every such specialization as covered, even though the analytic classification is absent there.
Search completeness is limited; failure to retrieve an equivalent source is not evidence of guaranteed originality.

value.rationale: The criterion is a natural D-optimal single-sensor volume objective on the smallest path with nontrivial strict interior placement. The explicit two-threshold conductance phase diagram and exact minimal graph size reveal a qualitative optimizer relocation and four-way symmetry tie that fixed-instance algorithms do not expose as a global design law. The result informs whether to place a sensor at an endpoint, near the strong link, or next to the weak outer link without diagonalizing or integrating the dynamics. It is not merely a single arbitrary numerical slice.
